unemu-at-bios-1.0.2-unemu.3-src

Corresponding source for the 32 KiB system BIOS that the unemupc98 emulator
project builds from unemu-at-bios, the unemu fork of Sergey Kiselev's
8088_bios adapted as the open AT BIOS of the unemu machines (repository
https://github.com/unemu-org/at-bios), configuration MACHINE_UNEMU_AT:

  bios-unemu-at.bin  flake output unemu-at, 32,768 bytes
    SHA-256 6938dc8b665fa120f33775163ab6bacc559389525db87adedf734416f9ef2442

Contents

  unemu-at-bios/  the fork at release tag v1.0.2-unemu.3, revision
                  4548c1769aed67323979d5fa8eff52eed266b64b: the tree Nix
                  builds the ROM from, with upstream's prebuilt images left
                  out: binaries/ and xtide_r625/ are build outputs, not
                  source, the ROM above contains neither, and xtide_r625/
                  holds XTIDE Universal BIOS r625 binaries whose source is
                  not part of this archive. Upstream's flash-image targets
                  that combine the BIOS with those binaries (the *-xtide*.rom
                  images in src/Makefile and CMakeLists.txt) therefore do not
                  build from this archive. Nothing else is changed.
                  README.unemu.md lists the changes from upstream 8088_bios
                  1.0.2.
  NOTICE          this file.

Licence

  GPL-3.0-or-later. Copyright (C) 2010 - 2026 Sergey Kiselev, the author of
  the BIOS; the unemu contributors' changes are additions under the same
  terms. See the file headers and unemu-at-bios/LICENSE.txt.

Rebuild

  With Nix (flakes enabled), from the unemu-at-bios directory; flake.nix and
  flake.lock pin the toolchain:

    nix build .#unemu-at    # result/bios-unemu-at.bin

  The result must match the SHA-256 value above.
